Name: Adiel, Father of Maasiai
Summary: Father of Maasiai the priest, son of Jahzerah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:12: Father of Maasiai the priest, son of Jahzerah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Adiel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
